items.title: Drzewiecki Goes Back-to-Back on B1G Weekly Honors
items.summary: For the second week in a row and third time overall this season, Minnesota fifth-year kicker Luke Drzewiecki has been named the Big Ten Special Teams Player of the Week.

items.title: Gophers Fall in Overtime at #4 Indiana 23-16
items.summary: Minnesota and Indiana traded 60-yard field goals in the final 19 seconds of regulation, but the #4 Hoosiers managed to escape with a 23-16 win in overtime.

items.title: Baranowski a Butkus Award Semifinalist
items.summary: Minnesota fifth-year senior Maverick Baranowski has been named one of 15 semifinalists for the Butkus Award, given annually to the nation's top linebacker.

items.title: Game 8 Preview: Minnesota at Indiana
items.summary: Meeting for the first time since 2021, RV/RV Minnesota visits defending national champion No. 4/4 Indiana Saturday. Kickoff is set for 2:30 p.m. on CBS and the Gopher Radio Network. The game will also be the site of ESPN's College Gameday, marking the third time Minnesota has been a part of the show (Michigan in 2020, Wisconsin in 2019).

items.title: Drzewiecki Takes Weekly Big Ten Honors
items.summary: Minnesota fifth-year kicker Luke Drzewiecki capped off his weekend heroics by being named the Big Ten Special Teams Player of the Week, the conference announced Monday.
